summary: Living devflow forge adapter cutover to the user-approved prepared-result workflow: the merge gate now prepares an immutable merge candidate (pr prepare --strategy ff) BEFORE CI/review/merge; a fix round re-pins the SAME PR via pr update (new snapshot generation) instead of abandon+recreate; a moved base re-prepares the SAME PR instead of the L1 stale-base recreate; an impossible --ff refuses not_fast_forward naming the rebase remedy (never a silent strategy switch); stale approvals cannot authorize a new result (the fixture enforces generation/candidate binding on review+CI+merge).

coreCommandAssumptions.source: RepairT2Review compact contract (hub message 1573aaf696606074) + primary-source verification against the core t2 worktree /Users/chenwenjie/.loop-worktrees/git-forge-66e3ca6d/forge-p2/t2 (src/pr_merge.rs cmd_pr_update, src/cli.rs cmd_pr_show generation line) + /tmp/p2-t2-review-repair.json findings.
coreCommandAssumptions.prPrepare: git forge pr prepare <n> --strategy merge|squash|rebase|ff — --strategy REQUIRED; ALWAYS materializes a NEW candidate against CURRENT state (never reuses); stdout: 'prepared PR #<n> for strategy <s> (candidate <result_commit>, generation <g>, base <base_head>)'; ff refusal wording: 'cannot fast-forward: the source does not sit directly on top of the current base tip of <base> (merge_base <mb> != base tip <tip>); use --strategy rebase to replay the source or recreate the PR'; re-prepare REPLACES the prior candidate.
coreCommandAssumptions.prUpdate: git forge pr update <n> — no flags; stdout 'PR #<n> updated to snapshot generation <k> (source <ref> -> <oid>)'; refuses when source tip unchanged or base moved (base-moved keeps the re-validate remedy).
coreCommandAssumptions.prMergeBinding: pr merge --ff with a prepared candidate BINDS it: candidate.generation == current generation, candidate.base_head == CURRENT base tip, strategy == merge flag, effective approve + latest ci.check bound to the candidate; finalize CASes base FROM candidate.base_head TO candidate.result_commit; any mismatch refuses with 'run git forge pr prepare <n> --strategy <s> then fresh ci run + review, then merge' (exit 1). Unprepared merge on a moved base refuses naming the prepare remedy. Unmoved-base merge without a candidate keeps legacy behavior.
coreCommandAssumptions.ciRunBinding: ci run with a valid candidate runs the plan against the CANDIDATE result commit and records the check bound to it; without a candidate, legacy source-snapshot run.
coreCommandAssumptions.prShow: additive 'generation: <n>' and 'prepared: strategy <s> result <hex>' lines (prose-only, safe for existing parsers).
coreCommandAssumptions.t7: Machine JSON interface (issue #7) is NOT landed; prose parsing stays. The adapter's FORGE_RE gains prUpdated/prPrepared/cannotFf/rePrepare/movedBaseNoCandidate prose shapes; the t7 machine-interface integration obligation remains (see remainingObligations).

scripts/devflow.cjs: FORGE_RE extended: prUpdated, prPrepared, cannotFf, rePrepare, movedBaseNoCandidate prose shapes (all matched on the forge's own words, never inferred).

forgeUpdatePR(missionDir, state, feature, prId): runs pr update, parses the generation line, mirrors forge_pr_updated; classifies base_moved (continue to prepare) and nothing_to_update (proceed) refusals; any other failure throws forgeBridgeError.

forgePreparePR(missionDir, state, feature, prId): runs pr prepare --strategy ff, parses the candidate line, mirrors forge_pr_prepared; cannot_ff returns { code: 'cannot_ff' }; any other failure throws forgeBridgeError.

forgeMergeFeature: (1) source-moved detection now calls forgeUpdatePR on the SAME PR (never abandon+recreate); update bridge failures pause RECOVERABLE forge_bridge_failed (feature stays in_review, self-clears on re-run); (2) prepare runs BEFORE ci run — CI, the ceremony approve and pr merge --ff all bind the prepared candidate; (3) prepare bridge failures pause RECOVERABLE forge_bridge_failed; (4) cannot_ff returns not_fast_forward naming the rebase remedy (never a silent strategy switch); (5) merge refusals movedBaseNoCandidate / movedBase / rePrepare all re-prepare the SAME PR (continue), never abandon+recreate; (6) supersededFrom dead code removed.
Adapter contract comment updated (P2 prepared-result workflow).
fixtures/devflow/fake-git-forge.cjs: PR records gain generation (0 = pr.created snapshot) and prepared ({strategy, result, base_head, source_head, generation}); pr show renders additive 'generation:' and 'prepared:' lines.

pr update handler: re-pins to the live source branch tip as generation+1, refuses on moved base or unchanged tip, INVALIDATES the prior decision/CI/prepared candidate (generation binding — stale approvals cannot authorize a new result).

pr prepare handler: --strategy required (usage error otherwise), ff-only emulated (mirrors the fixture's 'only --ff is emulated' merge surface), refuses cannot-ff against the CURRENT base tip with the core's exact wording, pins the candidate (re-prepare replaces).

pr merge handler: binds the prepared candidate (generation/base/strategy/review/CI checks with the core's re-prepare remedy wording); unprepared + moved base refuses naming the prepare remedy; CASes base from the candidate's base_head to the candidate result; merged line carries the candidate result.
ci run handler: records the check bound to the prepared candidate when one exists.
New injection scenarios: updateFail, prepareFail (consume-once bridge failures).
tests/devflow/forge-adapter.test.cjs: CR-06 rewritten: a fix round after gate_failed UPDATES the SAME PR (forge_pr_updated mirrored, generation 1), never supersedes; the approving review that authorized the merge was recorded after the update.
VAL-114 stale-base rewritten: the SAME PR survives the base move (re-prepare, never supersede); exactly one PR creation; >=2 forge_pr_prepared events.
VAL-117 window rewritten: created → prepared → re-prepared → merged on the SAME prId.

New P2 regression tests (5): (a) prepare → ci → review → merge ordering with candidate binding (merged == prepared result, reviewedCandidate == prepared result); (b) stale approval cannot authorize a new result (approve-before-update refused at the gate; final approve bound to the current generation's candidate); (c) pr prepare bridge failure pauses RECOVERABLE forge_bridge_failed and self-clears; (d) pr update bridge failure pauses RECOVERABLE forge_bridge_failed — the PR is never recreated/abandoned; (e) impossible --ff refuses not_fast_forward naming the rebase — never a silent strategy switch, merge never invoked.
